label: Wait
description: Pause this branch for a number of seconds, at no cost: the run parks on a timer and resumes when it fires. Whatever arrives on `value` comes out unchanged afterwards, so the node sits in the middle of a chain; `wokeAt` is when it resumed. To wait for a date instead, use WaitUntil.

inputs.name: seconds
inputs.label: Seconds
inputs.description: How long to wait, in seconds (fractions allowed). Must be more than zero.

inputs.name: value
inputs.label: Value
inputs.description: Passed through unchanged once the wait is over. Optional: the node also works as a pure delay on `_should_flow`.

outputs.name: value
outputs.description: The `value` that came in, emitted once the wait is over.
